svg.title: Book Tracker container and trust boundaries
svg.desc: The browser and Firebase Hosting form the delivery edge. Browser Firestore access is checked by Security Rules. Shared-catalog search, reader summaries, and administration use authorized Cloud Functions with Admin SDK access. External metadata and Toggl requests use their existing direct or mediated paths.
